attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changes core workflow abort semantics and makes WorkflowExecutionContext sealed/IDisposable with a new Cancel() API, so any third-party activities or workflow code depending on the old (effectively broken) per-call CancellationToken behavior or subclassing the context could see different runtime behavior."}

reason: Changes core workflow abort semantics and makes WorkflowExecutionContext sealed/IDisposable with a new Cancel() API, so any third-party activities or workflow code depending on the old (effectively broken) per-call CancellationToken behavior or subclassing the context could see different runtime behavior.
